extracted.intended_audience: consumers researching or buying vehicles (Car shoppers, Consumer Reports readers)
extracted.subtask_description: Evaluation criteria and specifications used by Consumer Reports to review and compare a passenger vehicle (here, the 2019 Toyota Camry), covering safety, reliability, fuel economy, owner satisfaction, features, and model-history notes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Green Choice (EPA low-emitting certification)
rubrics_metrics.description: The EPA has certified this vehicle as among the 20 percent lowest-emitting passenger vehicles for its model year, based on government greenhouse gas and smog ratings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used to indicate vehicles qualifying as low-emission choices within their model year; shown prominently as 'GREEN CHOICE' on the listing.

rubrics_metrics.name: EPA MPG (fuel economy)
rubrics_metrics.description: EPA MPG: 32 mpg
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Official EPA combined fuel-economy rating used as a primary measure of efficiency and to compare models (page shows EPA MPG for each model variant).

rubrics_metrics.name: Owner-reported MPG
rubrics_metrics.description: Owner Reported MPG: (field shown alongside EPA MPG)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Real-world fuel economy reported by owners, presented in parallel with EPA ratings to provide practical context.

rubrics_metrics.name: Recall alerts / number of recalls
rubrics_metrics.description: RECALL ALERT: There are 6 recalls on this vehicle.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Count of active recalls is shown as an alert and is a safety/used-buying consideration; links to details ('Learn More').

rubrics_metrics.name: Overall Reliability
rubrics_metrics.description: Overall Reliability (displayed on a 0-100 scale for model-year reliability comparisons).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consumer Reports' reliability score used to compare model-year cohorts and against similar cars; appears in summary and in 'See All Models Reliability' context.

rubrics_metrics.name: Owner Satisfaction (overall)
rubrics_metrics.description: Owner Satisfaction (aggregate metric summarizing owner feelings about the vehicle).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Presented alongside subdimensions (Driving Experience, Comfort, Value) and shown historically by model year; used to gauge long-term owner happiness.

rubrics_metrics.name: Driving Experience (owner-rated)
rubrics_metrics.description: Driving Experience / 100
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Owner-rated subscore indicating how owners judge the car's driving dynamics and feel; shown numerically out of 100.

rubrics_metrics.name: Comfort (owner-rated)
rubrics_metrics.description: Comfort / 100
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Owner-rated subscore for interior comfort and ride quality; presented as a numeric score.

rubrics_metrics.name: Value (owner-rated)
rubrics_metrics.description: Value / 100
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Owner-rated assessment of the vehicle's value for money; shown as a numeric score and used when comparing prices and features.

rubrics_metrics.name: Road Test / Expert driving impressions
rubrics_metrics.description: Road Test: 'The new Camry offers sleeker styling, but it's the improved fuel economy and handling, plus standard advanced safety systems, that distinguish it among the crowd of midsized sedans.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Professional road-test commentary covering styling, fuel economy, handling, and standard advanced safety systems — used to summarize how the car performs in Consumer Reports testing and how it compares within its class.

rubrics_metrics.name: Crash Tests (IIHS & NHTSA ratings)
rubrics_metrics.description: IIHS Front Moderate Overlap: Good; IIHS Front Small Overlap, Driver: Good; IIHS Side Crash: Good; NHTSA Overall Crash (and frontal/side subratings).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Official crashworthiness test outcomes from IIHS and NHTSA are listed explicitly and are key safety evaluation metrics; results influence overall safety assessment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Typical Price / Used price range
rubrics_metrics.description: Price ranges shown for models (example: '2019 Toyota Camry $14,375 - $18,500').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Displayed used-price ranges help assess value and market positioning versus competitors; used with 'Value' scores.

rubrics_metrics.name: Features & Specs (body style, seating, drive wheels)
rubrics_metrics.description: Features & Specs: Body Style — sedan; Seating — 2 front, 3 rear; Drive Wheels — Front.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Basic vehicle configuration/specifications used to categorize the car and set expectations for capacity and drivetrain.

rubrics_metrics.name: Engines Available
rubrics_metrics.description: Engines Available: 2.5-liter 4 (206 hp); 2.5-liter 4 hybrid (208 hp); 2.5-liter 4 (203 hp); 3.5-liter V6 (301 hp).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Lists engine options and horsepower; used to evaluate performance, fuel economy trade-offs, and trim differentiation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Transmissions Available
rubrics_metrics.description: Transmissions Available: 8-speed automatic; CVT.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Transmission types affect driving feel and fuel economy; listed to inform test expectations and buyer choices.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cargo Volume
rubrics_metrics.description: Cargo Volume: (listed in cu. ft. on the page).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Practical storage capacity used to assess utility for buyers; part of the spec sheet.

rubrics_metrics.name: Warranty coverage
rubrics_metrics.description: Warranty: 'Coverage varies among versions of this vehicle... the dealership can tell you exactly how much warranty is left.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Information on remaining/standard warranty coverage is provided as an ownership consideration; guidance notes VIN-based differences and dealership verification.

rubrics_metrics.name: Model History / Redesign year impacts
rubrics_metrics.description: Model History entries (e.g., 2018 Redesign Year: 'Based on an all-new platform... lower center of gravity aimed at making it more aerodynamic and fuel efficient...' and notes for 2012-2017, 2007-2011, etc.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluates how generational changes (redesign years) affect interior quality, handling, fuel economy, safety equipment, infotainment, and other long-term considerations when choosing a model year.

rubrics_metrics.name: Standard and optional safety equipment
rubrics_metrics.description: Standard safety equipment described: forward collision warning with automatic braking and pedestrian detection, lane departure warning with lane keeping assistance, adaptive cruise control. Available: blind spot warning and rear cross traffic warning. Later-model standard additions include AEB with pedestrian and cyclist detection, BSW, and RCTW.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Presence or absence of specific active-safety features is highlighted as distinguishing features and affects both road-test impressions and safety rankings; availability by trim/year is important for buyers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Hybrid variant fuel economy
rubrics_metrics.description: EPA MPG for hybrid variants: examples shown include 'Toyota Camry Hybrid EPA MPG 52 mpg' and historic hybrid mpg values (e.g., 'the hybrid got an impressive 38 mpg' for earlier generation).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Hybrid-specific fuel-economy numbers are presented separately and compared to non-hybrid variants to show efficiency gains and inform buyer trade-offs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Optional equipment effect on safety ratings
rubrics_metrics.description: Note in model history: 'Look for examples with the optional curtain airbags noted on the headliner. Without them, this generation of the Camry received a poor rating in the IIHS side-crash test.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Highlights that optional equipment (e.g., curtain airbags) can materially affect crash-test outcomes and thus should be checked when evaluating used examples.
